text_block_list.name: Tact & F
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything! Thank you very 
much.
choice_data_list: No, thank you for participating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year 
concluded smoothly. Today also marks the 
end of our joint training with Daring Tact 
and Efforia.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I have learned so much from you. I promise 
to make every bit of it part of who I am!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"For future training, I will take 
Epi-san's records as my target."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! Please do! Heheh, I'm so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"My record is gonna improve even more! At 
the next Tenno Sho (Autumn), I'll 
'definitely'...—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: (...I can't say for certain, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through training at the camp, Epiphaneia 
has grown even further... but she has yet 
to regain her confidence.
choice_data_list:
Epi's definitely gonna win the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) too!

Epi's definitely going to win the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I want to say 'definitely'... 
just like you do."
choice_data_list: Yeah...
That's true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can say "definitely" is 
because as her Trainer, I believe in 
her—and I have confidence in my own 
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Tokyo Yushun where I let her run 
out of control... I put my own position on 
the line as proof of my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I racked my brain for what was needed to 
help her evolve... and we took on the 
challenge together. That journey of trial 
and error turned into true confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going through trial and error, she 
too will surely be able to call herself 
"absolute" once more.
choice_data_list: You have to find your own "voice" too.
You have to find your own "voice" too

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: My own "voice"... What could that mean—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: —I'm so sorry I'm late...!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Epi-san and the others... Thank 
goodness, mind if I sit next to you?
choice_data_list: Sure, sounds good.
Sure, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since our paths no longer crossed, it had 
been a while since I had a proper chat 
with Logotype. She seemed to have had a 
rough time with injuries lately, but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo? What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing~ ...Ah, looks like the 
bus is leaving.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After driving for a while, the bus made a 
temporary stop at a service area for a 
break.
choice_data_list:
(That's right, maybe I should bring some 
drinks for them)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I returned after buying canned juice, 
she was no longer on the bus. So I set out 
to search for her—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: —The breeze feels so nice here~.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You bet!! There's so much greenery, too!!
choice_data_list: (…Looks like someone's already here)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quietly turned on my heel. Perhaps 
talking with someone her age might give 
Epiphaneia some strength—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was surprised. To see you on the 
bus, Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Normally, she'd be the very first to rush 
out.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The voice of destiny is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...For example, you know.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The path I thought led straight to my 
destination turned out not to at all, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If it were a road where you wouldn't know 
where it leads unless you walked it... 
what would you do?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... Shall we just start walking for 
now~? Moving forward is better than just 
standing around, at least.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no guarantee we'll reach 
our destination! Are you sure you want to 
keep going?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. I was just thinking about 
how amazing you are, Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
You know, Epi-san... usually, there's no 
such thing as absolute certainty.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm going to take that step 
forward. —Believing in my own eyes, my 
senses, and my legs."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very adroit, y'see~. So I kinda 
have no choice but to believe that.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's your voice—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm gonna try searching for all 
kinds of "voices"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I still can't hear my own inner voice... 
So for now, I'll start by listening to 
what others have to say!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, I'm sure I'll find my own 
unique answer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that's good.
Yeah, I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Who am I even supposed to ask, though?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, she would have recklessly 
charged in and grabbed every Umamusume in 
sight. But right now, she desires 
guidelines...
choice_data_list: What kinda story do you wanna hear, Epi?

What kind of story would you like to hear, 
Epi?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! A way to say "absolute" to the girl 
watching my back... huh!?
choice_data_list:
Then... maybe a girl in the same position 
as you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What's making Epiphaneia hesitate is a 
sense of responsibility born from wanting 
to guide someone... There's someone at the 
academy who carries that exact same 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For it is because so many Umamusume— chase 
after the back of someone they admire and 
begin running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They, too, must be confronting their own 
positions in their own way—
choice_data_list:
You've got someone chasing after your back 
too, don't you?

You also have someone chasing after your 
back, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer! Alright, I'm heading 
out—
choice_data_list: Wait, Epi!
Wait, Epi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In my hand was the canned juice I had 
forgotten to give her earlier. I tossed it 
lightly so she could catch it—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, you'll definitely find the 
answer.

It's okay, you'll definitely find the 
answer

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you! Just wait for me!!
